raw_response:
I’m still going with the wheat-maize rotation on all 10.1 mu. That’s what I know best, and on this small area I cannot afford to gamble. I’ve farmed here many years, and if wheat is managed steadily and maize is planted quickly after harvest, the land usually gives me a reliable return. The extension people talk about cutting fertilizer sometimes, but on my fields I don’t like pressing too low. If wheat turns yellow or maize starts weak, the loss is bigger than the savings. At the same time, my family has only 2 people and some off-farm work, so I need simple operations, not too many passes. I have well water, but pumping costs money, so I’ll irrigate at the key stages, not blindly.
